extracted.intended_audience: animal nutrition researchers, extension specialists, modelers, and practitioners seeking authoritative nutrient-requirement references
extracted.subtask_description: A web landing page listing National Research Council (NRC) species-specific reports that provide authoritative, state-of-the-art recommendations for meeting nutrient requirements of agricultural, companion, and aquacultural animals; links to additional NANP modeling resources are also pointed to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritative state-of-the-art recommendations for nutrient requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The National Research Council (NRC) generates species-specific reports that serve as the authoritative source of state-of-the-art recommendations for meeting nutrient requirements of agricultural animals, companion animals, and aquacultural species alike.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These NRC reports are intended to be used as primary references for nutrient-requirement recommendations; the page points users to additional data-modeling resources on the NANP Nutrient Requirement Models page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Species-specific report coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: NRC reports are organized and published on a per-species basis (e.g., Beef (2016), Swine (2012), Horses (2007), Dairy (2001), Poultry (2026), Small Ruminants (2007), Fish and Shrimp (2011), Dogs and Cats (2006)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should consult the report corresponding to the target species for species-tailored nutrient recommendations; the page lists the latest report year per species and links to those reports.
